say:1:1631211001:1.text: Interested in the court mage selection, eh?
say:1:1631211001:1.source_cn: 看来您也对这场万众瞩目的宫廷魔法师角逐感兴趣？
say:1:1631211001:1.male: Interested in the court mage selection, eh?
say:1:1631211001:1.female: Interested in the court mage selection, eh?

say:2:1631211002:1.text: The odds are clear! Miss Cassadee, a prodigy with tons of support. Naturally, her payout's lower.
say:2:1631211002:1.source_cn: 不瞒您说，现在的风向很明确。科丝蒂小姐，天赋异禀，支持...
say:2:1631211002:1.male: The odds are clear! Miss Cassadee, a prodigy with tons of support. Naturally, her payout's lower.
say:2:1631211002:1.female: The odds are clear! Miss Cassadee, a prodigy with tons of support. Naturally, her payout's lower.

say:3:1631211003:1.text: But if you're chasing returns... Sir Gervan is a strong contender too. He comes from a strong magical lineage and is just as much a rising star as Miss Cassadee.
say:3:1631211003:1.source_cn: 但您要是追求回报……格墨文先生也是不错的选择，家学渊源...
say:3:1631211003:1.male: But if you're chasing returns... Sir Gervan is a strong contender too. He comes from a strong magical lineage and is just as much a rising star as Miss Cassadee.
say:3:1631211003:1.female: But if you're chasing returns... Sir Gervan is a strong contender too. He comes from a strong magical lineage and is just as much a rising star as Miss Cassadee.

say:4:1631211004:1.text: And of course, there are other candidates with their own strengths.
say:4:1631211004:1.source_cn: 当然，还有几位候选人也各有千秋。
say:4:1631211004:1.male: And of course, there are other candidates with their own strengths.
say:4:1631211004:1.female: And of course, there are other candidates with their own strengths.

say:5:1631211005:1.text: Care to make a prediction? The more you bet, the more you win!
say:5:1631211005:1.source_cn: 怎么样，要预测一下，试试您的眼光吗？多下注，多多回报！
say:5:1631211005:1.male: Care to make a prediction? The more you bet, the more you win!
say:5:1631211005:1.female: Care to make a prediction? The more you bet, the more you win!

choice_prompt:6:1631211005.text: Care to make a prediction? The more you bet, the more you win!
choice_prompt:6:1631211005.source_cn: 怎么样，要预测一下，试试您的眼光吗？多下注，多多回报！
choice_prompt:6:1631211005.male: Care to make a prediction? The more you bet, the more you win!
choice_prompt:6:1631211005.female: Care to make a prediction? The more you bet, the more you win!

say:7:1631211006:1.text: A safe bet! You've got a discerning eye!
say:7:1631211006:1.source_cn: 有眼光！稳扎稳打！一看您就是明白人！
say:7:1631211006:1.male: A safe bet! You've got a discerning eye!
say:7:1631211006:1.female: A safe bet! You've got a discerning eye!

say:8:1631211009:1.text: All bets recorded! Now we wait and see!
say:8:1631211009:1.source_cn: 我记下您的投注了！接下来就让咱们拭目以待吧！
say:8:1631211009:1.male: All bets recorded! Now we wait and see!
say:8:1631211009:1.female: All bets recorded! Now we wait and see!

say:10:1631211007:1.source_cn: 换做我的话，也选格墨文少爷！

say:11:1631211008:1.text: What a bold choice! I like your spirit!
say:11:1631211008:1.source_cn: 休……您果然魄力十足！我就欣赏您这样的冒险精神！
say:11:1631211008:1.male: What a bold choice! I like your spirit!
say:11:1631211008:1.female: What a bold choice! I like your spirit!
